text:
Situation: Metoclopramide hydrochloride 15 mg/0.07 mL, 9.8 mL bottles are low at Corvale East with 44 units (4.9 days of supply at 8.9 units per day). Corvale General holds 256 units (29.1 days at 8.8 units per day). A ranked transfer option moves 82 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving the sender with 20 days of supply and bringing the receiver to 14 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include metoclopramide hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: No national shortage is reported. The imbalance is local. Corvale East is at risk of stockout within five days. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a transfer while maintaining adequate supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute the transfer of 82 units from Corvale General to Corvale East per pharmacy director approval to rebalance inventory across sites.

Not recommended: No allocation changes, alternative sourcing, or clinical restrictions at this time.
